definitions.explanation: describes drinks (especially wine and sake) or food that has a rich, well-developed flavor and aroma

examples.japanese: {芳醇|ほうじゅん}なワインを{楽|たの}しむ。
このお{酒|さけ}は{芳醇|ほうじゅん}な{香|かお}りがする。
examples.english: This sake has a rich aroma.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{熟成|じゅくせい}させた{芳醇|ほうじゅん}な{味|あじ}わいのウイスキー。
examples.english: A whisky with mellow flavor from years of aging.

notes:
USAGE:
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}なワイン (full-bodied wine)
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}な{香|かお}り (rich aroma)
- {芳醇|ほうじゅん}な{味|あじ}わい (mellow flavor)
Primarily used to describe alcoholic beverages (wine, sake, whisky) and sometimes coffee, cheese, or other aged/fermented products.
A refined, literary word often found in product descriptions and wine/sake reviews. Implies quality and sophistication.

RELATED WORDS:
- {芳香|ほうこう} (fragrance)
- {熟成|じゅくせい} (aging, maturing)
- {濃厚|のうこう} (rich, thick - for texture)
